title: First Evaluation Loop
summary: Install qym, wire a dataset and metrics, run an evaluation, then inspect the result in the platform.
paragraphs: This is the fastest path to first success for a new developer.
Keep the first run intentionally small so task or environment problems are obvious before you scale up.
steps: Install the SDK and verify the CLI is available.
Choose a small example or task function and point it at a dataset or local CSV.
Run `qym config check` if the platform is involved.
Execute `qym run create` with a minimal metric set.
Inspect the run locally or open the platform to review item-level output.
common_mistakes: Starting with judge metrics before the baseline task and connectivity work.
Using a large dataset on the first run, which hides simple setup failures.
next_steps: Move to multi-model or CI workflows once the baseline loop is stable.

title: Offline Run To Platform Review
summary: Run locally or in an isolated environment, persist artifacts, then upload them into the shared platform later.
paragraphs: This is the right workflow for air-gapped evaluation or for environments where direct platform streaming is not possible.
steps: Run the evaluation locally with a CSV or local dataset source.
Collect the saved run artifact from `qym_results/`.
Transfer the artifact to a network location that can reach the platform.
Review the run in the platform and trigger AI analysis if needed.
